title: Acquisition by Vishnu Rooplal Wadhwan of 49 Percent Shares in Yogi Polypack Industries Limited
title_sw: Acquisition by Vishnu Rooplal Wadhwan of 49 Percent Shares in Yogi Polypack Industries Limited
text: Vishnu Rooplal Wadhwan notified the Fair Competition Commission (FCC) of his intention to acquire 49 percent shares in Yogi Polypack Industries Limited. The transaction supports the Acquirer's strategic goal of expanding its presence in the packaging material. The relevant market under spotlight was defined as manufacture and supply of High-density polyethylene (HDPE) and PolyPropylene (PP) packaging materials in Mainland Tanzania. Based on the nature of the structure of proposed transaction and due to the absence of horizontal overlaps between activities of the merging firms, structure of the relevant market will remain the same and there is no appreciable impact to the structure of market after the approval of the proposed transaction therefore, transaction was approved without conditions.
